fullPassage: How does music improve cognition? Music listening and especially music-making is stimulating many psychological functions; however, core functions addressed by musical activities are executive functions. These include attention, working memory, planning, and motor control, all relying on networks predominantly located in the frontal cortex. Musical engagement was found to increase grey matter density in frontal brain areas involved in controlling the practised task. Further evidence that musical practice involves the frontal cortex in elderly adults has been provided by Sluming et al. These authors demonstrated that musicians who practise beyond 60 years of age show less or no degeneration of grey matter density in the frontal cortex. Thus, practising a musical instrument seems to prevent degeneration of the frontal cortex and deterioration of the above-mentioned executive functions. Results of Verghese et al. hint in the same direction, demonstrating that Alzheimer’s dementia is less common in the elderly who are regularly involved in musical activities.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① improve — increase — prevent

(A) improve(향상시키다): 글 전체가 음악이 인지 기능을 좋게 만든다는 내용이므로 '향상시키다'가 맞아요. worsen(악화시키다)은 정반대예요.

(B) increase(증가시키다): 음악 활동이 회백질 밀도를 '늘렸다'는 연구 결과이므로 increase가 맞아요. decrease(감소시키다)는 흐름과 반대예요.

(C) prevent(막다): 악기 연습이 전두엽 피질의 퇴화를 '막아 준다'는 결론이므로 prevent가 맞아요. cause(초래하다)는 정반대예요.
det.tip: 글의 방향(음악=인지에 이로움)을 잡으면 improve·increase·prevent가 한 세트로 보여요.

❌ ① frequent(잦은): common과 비슷한 뜻의 동의어예요.

❌ ③ widespread(널리 퍼진): common과 같은 방향의 동의어예요.

❌ ④ silent(조용한): 흔함과 무관한 다른 의미축의 단어예요.
det.tip: common(흔한) ↔ rare(드문). frequent·widespread는 동의어라 함정이에요.

questions.passage:
(A) Scientists carefully study the grey <u>matter</u> found inside the human brain. This soft tissue is responsible for processing information and controlling movement.

(B) The teacher told the students that their honest opinions truly <u>matter</u>. She promised to consider every single comment before making a final decision.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)의 밑줄 친 matter의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절하게 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ (A) 물질 — (B) 중요하다

(A) grey matter(회백질)처럼 뇌 속의 '물질(조직)'을 가리키는 명사 용법이에요. 본문의 grey matter density와 같은 쓰임이에요.

(B) 학생들의 의견이 '중요하다'는 동사 용법이에요. matter가 동사로 쓰이면 'be important'의 뜻이에요.

❌ ① 두 의미가 서로 뒤바뀌었어요.

❌ ②·④ (A)를 '중요하다/문제'로, (B)를 '문제'로 보면 두 문맥 모두 맞지 않아요.
det.tip: matter: ① (명사) 물질, 문제 ② (동사) 중요하다

questions.stem:
다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"the process of becoming worse or weaker over a period of time"

det.korean: 시간이 지나며 점점 나빠지거나 약해지는 과정 = degeneration(퇴화)
det.analysis:
✅ ① degeneration(퇴화): '시간이 지나며 점점 나빠지는 과정'이라는 정의와 일치해요. 본문에서 전두엽 피질의 degeneration(퇴화)을 막는다고 했어요.

❌ ② improvement(개선): 오히려 좋아지는 것이라 정의와 반대예요.

❌ ③ measurement(측정): 크기·양을 재는 것으로 무관해요.

❌ ④ agreement(합의): 의견 일치로 무관해요.
det.tip: degeneration: (기능·조직의) 퇴화, 쇠퇴

questions.passage: Results of Verghese et al. hint in the same direction, demonstrating that Alzheimer’s dementia is less common in the elderly who are __________ (regular) involved in musical activities.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.analysis:
빈칸 문장: the elderly who are __________ (regular) involved in musical activities.

→ 빈칸은 뒤의 involved(관여하는)를 꾸미는 자리이므로 부사가 필요해요.
→ 형용사 regular(규칙적인)를 부사 regularly(규칙적으로)로 바꿔요.

따라서 정답은 regularly예요.
det.tip: 형용사 + -ly = 부사: regular → regularly(규칙적으로)

questions.passage: Thus, practising a musical instrument seems to prevent degeneration of the frontal cortex and __________ (deteriorate) of the above-mentioned executive functions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.analysis:
빈칸 문장: prevent degeneration of the frontal cortex and __________ (deteriorate) of ~.

→ and로 앞의 명사 degeneration과 나란히 연결되는 자리이므로 명사가 필요해요.
→ 동사 deteriorate(악화되다)를 명사 deterioration(악화)으로 바꿔요.

따라서 정답은 deterioration이에요.
det.tip: deteriorate(동사: 악화되다) → deterioration(명사: 악화)

questions.passage: How does music improve cognition? Music listening and especially music-making is stimulating many psychological functions; however, core functions addressed by musical activities are executive functions. These include attention, __________, planning, and motor control, all relying on networks predominantly located in the frontal cortex. Musical engagement was found to increase grey matter density in frontal brain areas involved in controlling the practised task. Further evidence that musical practice involves the frontal cortex in elderly adults has been provided by Sluming et al. These authors demonstrated that musicians who practise beyond 60 years of age show less or no degeneration of grey matter density in the frontal cortex. Thus, practising a musical instrument seems to prevent degeneration of the frontal cortex and deterioration of the above-mentioned executive functions. Results of Verghese et al. hint in the same direction, demonstrating that Alzheimer’s dementia is less common in the elderly who are regularly involved in musical activities.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② working memory(작업 기억): 빈칸은 주의(attention), 계획(planning), 운동 제어(motor control)와 나란히 나열되는 '실행 기능'의 한 종류예요. 이 흐름에 맞는 인지 기능은 작업 기억이에요.

❌ ① long jumps(멀리뛰기): 운동 종목으로 인지 기능 목록에 맞지 않아요.

❌ ③ musical talent(음악적 재능): 실행 기능의 종류가 아니에요.

❌ ④ body weight(체중): 인지 기능과 무관해요.
det.tip: executive functions(실행 기능)에는 attention, working memory, planning, motor control이 포함돼요.

questions.passage: How does music improve cognition? Music listening and especially music-making is stimulating many psychological functions; however, core functions addressed by musical activities are executive functions. These include attention, working memory, planning, and motor control, all relying on networks predominantly located in the frontal cortex. Musical engagement was found to increase grey matter density in frontal brain areas involved in controlling the practised task. Further evidence that musical practice involves the frontal cortex in elderly adults has been provided by Sluming et al. These authors demonstrated that musicians who practise beyond 60 years of age show less or no degeneration of grey matter density in the frontal cortex. Thus, practising a musical instrument seems to prevent degeneration of the frontal cortex and deterioration of the above-mentioned executive functions. Results of Verghese et al. hint __________, demonstrating that Alzheimer’s dementia is less common in the elderly who are regularly involved in musical activities.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸: in the same direction(같은 방향으로, 같은 결론을 시사하며)
det.analysis:
✅ ④ in the same direction(같은 방향으로): Verghese 등의 결과가 앞선 연구들과 '같은 방향'을 가리킨다는 뜻이에요. 뒤에 이어지는 '치매가 덜 흔하다'는 내용이 앞의 보호 효과와 일치해요.

❌ ① against all odds(모든 역경을 무릅쓰고): 문맥과 무관한 표현이에요.

❌ ② for the first time(처음으로): '추가 증거'라는 흐름과 맞지 않아요.

❌ ③ without any proof(아무 증거 없이): 오히려 결과로 뒷받침한다고 했으므로 반대예요.
det.tip: hint in the same direction: 같은 결론을 시사하다(앞 연구와 일치)
